text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that overnight on-street permit parking be introduced on St. Cuthberts Road between Bayview Avenue to Bessborough Drive from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m. Residents requested the implementation of overnight on-street permit parking on St. Cuthberts Road, between Bayview Avenue and Bessborough Drive to accommodate their long-term parking needs.

North York Community Council: 1. Authorized parking by permit only on a street name basis from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m. daily on the odd (south) side of St. Cuthberts Road, from Bayview Avenue to Bessborough Drive. 2. Prohibited parking at all times on the north side of St. Cuthberts Road between Bayview Avenue and Bessborough Drive.
